name: PublishTerraformPlan
description: Convert a saved Terraform binary plan to JSON and publish both files as a build artifact.
author: Freeson Li
helpMarkDown: Run after terraform plan -out=<file>, using the same Terraform version and initialized working directory. The generated JSON contains unredacted sensitive values; artifact access follows the pipeline's permissions.

inputs.name: planFile
inputs.label: Binary plan file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Existing binary plan created by terraform plan -out. Relative paths resolve against Working directory. The artifact preserves the binary file's name.

inputs.name: jsonFileName
inputs.label: JSON plan filename
inputs.helpMarkDown: Filename inside the artifact, ending in .plan.json so the Terraform Plans tab can discover it.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build artifact containing only the binary plan and generated JSON. Use a distinct name for each invocation in a run.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Initialized Terraform directory used to create the binary plan, including its provider plugins.

inputs.name: terraformCliPath
inputs.label: Terraform CLI path (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the Terraform executable. Leave empty to use terraform from PATH. Use the Terraform version that created the binary plan.
